sections.description: Internal Kingdom tool for managing Sermons, Events, and Calendar views (with recurrence).
sections.changelog:
• Added Sermon Books filter based on scripture references.
  • Added Sermon Date filter using Month Year format.
  • Added filter visibility controls for shortcode and Elementor sermon widgets.
  • Added shortcode support for custom filter visibility settings.
  • Improved sermon filters responsive layout and container fitting.
  • Improved frontend filter spacing and rendering.
  • Minor fixes and refinements.
